remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated and spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath rental in the highly sought-after waterfront community of Shippan Point! Nestled in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. Freshly painted throughout and featuring brand new, stunning hardwood floors, the home is filled with natural light, especially in the inviting living room with a charming bay window. The open eat-in kitchen offers ample cabinetry, plus a dishwasher, oven, and refrigerator for easy meal prep and entertaining. The large primary bedroom suite includes a private full bath with a shower stall and a generous closet. Two additional spacious bedrooms share a full hallway bathroom with a shower/tub combo. You'll also enjoy the convenience of a dedicated laundry room with full-size washer/dryer units and extra storage. Outdoor deck space located off the kitchen with a shared fully fenced level backyard. Heat and hot water are included, optional basement storage, and additional parking in the shared driveway. Landscaping and snow removal are taken care of by the landlord, so you can relax and enjoy everything this wonderful location has to offer. Just minutes from Stamford's beaches, parks, downtown shops, restaurants, and Metro-North-Shippan Point is the ideal place to call home!
